{
  "title": "The Midnight Passenger",
  "world": "A remote, snow-dusted railway station in a valley where the clocks stopped ticking in 1994. The air tastes of iron and frost.",
  "cold_open": "The old station had been closed for decades. Until one winter night, the silence of the valley was broken by a low, rhythmic thrum—a heartbeat of steel against ice.",
  "question": "Who is the traveler, and why did they choose a destination that no longer exists?",
  "journey": "The tracks are buried under a shroud of white, yet the rails begin to hum. A single headlight pierces the fog, a warm amber eye cutting through the blue night. The steam rises in heavy, ghost-white plumes, swirling around the rusted signs. Then, the screech of brakes—a metallic sigh. The train exhales a cloud of heat, settling into the snow. One door opens. One foot hits the gravel. The passenger is small, wrapped in a coat that smells of old wool and lavender. They carry a single suitcase, its leather worn smooth by time. They stand on the platform, looking at the empty tracks ahead, and place a single, withered flower on the bench. They don't look back as they walk into the shadows of the village.",
  "discovery": "The train does not leave a trail of smoke behind; it simply fades into the mist, leaving only the smell of steam and the lingering warmth of a memory.",
  "emotional_turn": "The passenger isn't looking for a way home; they are looking for a way back.",
  "payoff": "The station is silent again. But on the bench, the flower remains, perfectly preserved by the frost.",
  "after_image": "The feeling of a door closing softly in a house you haven't visited in years.",
  "hero_shot": "A wide cinematic shot of the steam train’s amber headlight illuminating a single, frost-covered flower left on a weathered wooden bench as the mist swallows the tracks."
}
